item_text: I have sufficient freedom to decide how I carry out my assigned responsibilities.
I can use my judgment when determining the best way to complete my work.
I have an appropriate level of control over the sequence or approach I use to perform my tasks.
Within the requirements of my role, I can make decisions without unnecessary interference.
I understand how my work contributes to the objectives of my team or organization.
I can see the value that my work creates for the people who depend on it.
My responsibilities give me a sense that my contribution matters.
I understand why the work I do is important to the organization.
My work provides a suitable level of challenge for my current capabilities.
My responsibilities give me opportunities to develop and strengthen my skills.
I can take on challenging tasks without routinely feeling overwhelmed by their demands.
My work helps me build the competence I need to perform effectively.
